new_scholarship.name: Dean's International Award Program
new_scholarship.deadline: No scholarship application. Queen's states for each faculty International Admission Award: 'You will be considered automatically for this award, no application required.' The binding dates are the admission application deadlines: 'Applications are due for first-year full-time programs in Commerce, Health Science and Nursing' on February 1, 2027, and 'Applications are due for all first-year full-time programs, except Commerce, Health Sciences, and Nursing' on March 1, 2027.
new_scholarship.application_period: Students can begin applying to Queen's on October 1, 2026 for 2027 entry. Applications are due February 1, 2027 for first-year full-time Commerce, Health Science and Nursing, and March 1, 2027 for all other first-year full-time programmes. All supporting documents, including transcripts and English test scores, are due March 31, 2027. Award consideration is automatic at the point of admission.
new_scholarship.application_method: Automatic on admission. No separate scholarship application exists. Queen's states: 'International students who are entering undergraduate programs at Queen's University will be considered automatically for the Dean's International Award program.' Every eligible applicant who applies for admission to a covered faculty and is assessed as paying international tuition fees is considered, and the award tier is set by academic achievement.
new_scholarship.description: The Dean's International Award Program is Queen's University's automatic admission-award programme for international students entering the first year of a first-entry undergraduate degree programme in the Faculty of Arts and Science, the Smith School of Business (Bachelor of Commerce), the Stephen J. R. Smith School of Engineering and Applied Science, or the Faculty of Health Sciences (Bachelor of Health Sciences). It comprises four faculty awards - Arts and Science, Commerce, Engineering and Health Sciences International Admission Awards - published at CAD 5,000, 10,000, 15,000, 20,000 or 25,000 per year depending on faculty and standing, with a four-year duration renewable for three subsequent years. Each award requires no separate application, is made on academic achievement, and is available only to students paying international tuition fees.
new_scholarship.best_fit: First-year international applicants to Queen's University in Kingston with a very high admission average who are entering Arts and Science, Commerce, Engineering and Applied Science, or the Bachelor of Health Sciences and will be assessed at international tuition. Queen's International Student Hub markets these as 'Automatic scholarships and awards for international students with an average of 90%+'.
new_scholarship.funding_period: per year, renewable for up to 4 years
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be international students - Canadian citizens, students holding dual-citizenship and permanent residents of Canada do not qualify - and must be entering the first year of post-secondary education for the first time. They must be entering the first year of a first-entry undergraduate degree programme in the Faculty of Arts and Science, the Smith School of Engineering and Applied Science, the Smith School of Business (Bachelor of Commerce) or the Faculty of Health Sciences (Bachelor of Health Sciences), must be paying international student fees (international students paying domestic fees are excluded), and must be selected on academic achievement. Students in the Bachelor of Nursing program are excluded from the Health Sciences International Admission Award. Students with prior post-secondary education are not eligible for Queen's admission awards.

new_scholarship.english_requirement: Admission-level requirement, not a separate award requirement. Minimum: IELTS Academic Module 6.5 with no band below 6.0; TOEFL iBT 88 overall with a minimum of 20 in Writing, Speaking, Reading and Listening (before January 2026) or 4.5 overall with no skill below 4.0; CAEL overall band 70 with no band below 60; PTE Academic overall 60; Duolingo English Test 120; Cambridge English 175 with no component below 170; LanguageCert Academic 70 with no individual score below 65. Successful completion of Queen's School of English QBridge programming is also accepted. Test results are valid for a maximum of two years before beginning studies at Queen's.
new_scholarship.selection_notes: The award is not applied for: Queen's states 'You will be considered automatically for this award, no application required.' The stated criterion for all four faculty awards is academic achievement. The published value tiers (CAD 5,000 to CAD 25,000) indicate that the amount awarded is set by the strength of the admission record, but Queen's does not publish a tier-to-average mapping, a weighting, or a competition ratio. Renewal for the three subsequent years requires the student to continue to be registered full-time in a programme of study within the original faculty of admission. Where a student is selected for a named donor grade-based award, Queen's states the original automatic award may be replaced by that named award of equal or higher value.
new_scholarship.notes: Chosen from several distinct international undergraduate awards published by Queen's because the Dean's International Award Program is the best documented: official umbrella name, published per-faculty dollar tiers, published 4-year renewable duration, published eligibility and published renewal conditions. Distinct awards on the same host that are NOT recorded here and must not be duplicated as this record: the International Entrance Scholarship (formerly Queen's University International Entrance Scholarship, CAD 9,000 total, one year, all programmes, four available, no application required), the Principal's Global Scholars Undergraduate Award (for forcibly displaced students entering through the Global Scholars pathway, renewable up to three subsequent years on a 2.0 GPA, no amount published), the Principal's Scholarship (CAD 7,000, one year), the Mehran Bibi Sheikh Memorial Entrance Scholarship (CAD 1,500, one year, two available) and the Killam American Scholarship (CAD 9,000, one year, US citizens and permanent residents only). The award is tuition-side and partial: CAD 25,000 per year is roughly half of Queen's published 2026-2027 international total costs of CAD 47,324.31 (Arts and Science), CAD 57,366.58 (Computing), CAD 63,424.42 (Commerce Years 1-2), CAD 61,867.57 (Engineering and Applied Science) and CAD 38,283.46 (Health Sciences on-campus Year 1). No bond, service obligation or work requirement is published, and no number of awards is published.

programme_detail_official.deadline_note: This award has no deadline of its own because it requires no application - Queen's states for each faculty International Admission Award: 'You will be considered automatically for this award, no application required.' The dates that matter are the admission deadlines published by Undergraduate Admission and Recruitment for 2027 entry: applications open October 1, 2026; February 1, 2027 for first-year full-time Commerce, Health Science and Nursing; March 1, 2027 for all other first-year full-time programmes (Arts and Science, Engineering and Applied Science); March 31, 2027 for all documents including transcripts and English test scores. The earlier 1 February 2027 date is the effective deadline for students seeking the Commerce and Health Sciences International Admission Awards. No timezone is stated on the official deadline page; America/Toronto is used because all published dates are Queen's Ontario dates.
programme_detail_official.status_note: Applications to Queen's for 2027 entry opened on October 1, 2026 and are open now, with the main first-year application deadline on March 1, 2027. The award itself is an ongoing automatic admission award rather than a closed application cycle.
programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: PARTIAL, TUTION-SIDE AWARD. Queen's does not state on the award pages whether the Dean's International Award Program is formally restricted to tuition or may be disbursed from the student's fee account, so tuition coverage is not claimed as true; what is official is that eligibility requires the student to be paying international student fees, and the money reduces the tuition and fee bill. It is partial in every case: the published tiers are CAD 5,000 to CAD 25,000 per year against Queen's published 2026-2027 international undergraduate total costs of CAD 47,324.31 (Arts and Science, all degrees excluding Computing), CAD 57,366.58 (Computing), CAD 63,424.42 (Commerce Years 1-2), CAD 61,867.57 (Engineering and Applied Science) and CAD 38,283.46 (Health Sciences on-campus Year 1). At the top tier the award covers roughly half of an Arts and Science, Engineering or Commerce bill and about two thirds of Health Sciences; at the bottom tier about a tenth. The award also leaves the Student Association Levy (CAD 100-110), ancillary fees including health and dental (CAD 1,466.51-1,526.96) and the UHIP international health plan (CAD 948) uncovered.

programme_detail_official.description: The Dean's International Award Program is Queen's University Kingston's automatic admission-award programme for international students entering the first year of a first-entry undergraduate degree programme in the Faculty of Arts and Science, the Smith School of Business (Bachelor of Commerce), the Stephen J. R. Smith School of Engineering and Applied Science, or the Faculty of Health Sciences (Bachelor of Health Sciences). It comprises four faculty awards - Arts and Science, Commerce, Engineering and Health Sciences International Admission Awards - published at CAD 5,000, 10,000, 15,000, 20,000 or 25,000 per year, with a four-year duration renewable for three subsequent years while the student stays registered full-time in a programme within the original faculty of admission. Awards are made on academic achievement, require no separate application, and are available only to students paying international tuition fees. The award is a partial tuition-side award and does not cover living costs, ancillary fees or travel.
programme_detail_official.coverage: A renewable annual award of CAD 5,000 to CAD 25,000 depending on faculty, totalling up to CAD 100,000 over four years at the top tier. It reduces international tuition and fees at Queen's but does not cover them, and it does not cover living costs, travel, the Student Association Levy, ancillary fees or the UHIP international health plan.

application_readiness_checklist: Apply only to Arts and Science, Commerce, Engineering and Applied Science, or the Bachelor of Health Sciences - the awards do not exist outside those four faculties
Check your fee assessment is international; an international citizen status assessed at domestic tuition rates is explicitly ineligible
Confirm you have no prior post-secondary education, because students with prior post-secondary study are not eligible for any Queen's admission award
Target the top of the admission range; the published tiers run from CAD 5,000 to CAD 25,000 a year and Queen's markets automatic international awards to applicants with an average of 90%+
Plan on a 1 March 2027 application deadline for Arts and Science and Engineering, or 1 February 2027 if you are targeting Commerce or Health Sciences
Get documents in early - transcripts and English test scores are due 31 March 2027 and English results must be valid for no more than two years
Do not look for a scholarship application form; there is none, and any extra steps waste nothing because the only action that counts is the admission application
Budget the remaining tuition yourself: even the top CAD 25,000 tier leaves most of an international tuition bill uncovered
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a faculty outside the four covered ones, including Nursing inside Health Sciences
Being assessed at domestic tuition despite international citizenship status
Having prior post-secondary education, which bars the whole family of Queen's admission awards
Averaging below the range that triggers an award, since the award is entirely merit-driven and automatic
Missing the faculty-specific admission deadline - 1 February 2027 for Commerce, Health Science and Nursing versus 1 March 2027 elsewhere
Letting a Supplementary Application lapse for Commerce, Health Sciences or Nursing, which is mandatory and due 15 February 2027
English test scores expiring before enrolment, since results are valid for two years only
Assuming the award funds the whole degree; it is tuition-side and partial and leaves living costs entirely to the student
estimated_uncovered_costs: The balance of international tuition above the award tier. Against Queen's published 2026-2027 international total costs, a CAD 25,000 award leaves about CAD 22,324 (Arts and Science), CAD 32,367 (Computing), CAD 38,424 (Commerce Years 1-2), CAD 36,868 (Engineering and Applied Science) and CAD 13,283 (Health Sciences on-campus Year 1) outstanding per year; the CAD 5,000 tier leaves proportionally more
Student Association Levy: CAD 100 per year in most faculties, CAD 110 in Commerce Years 1-2, Engineering and Health Sciences Year 1
Ancillary fees including health and dental: CAD 1,466.51 to CAD 1,526.96 per year depending on faculty
UHIP international student health plan: CAD 948 per year for a January start (CAD 632 for a May start)
Living costs: residence or housing, food, books, transit and incidentals, none of which the award touches
Travel to Canada, study permit and immigration costs
Any fifth year of study beyond the four-year renewable window
Any gap created if the student switches faculty, since renewal requires registration within the original faculty of admission
document_audit: Award documentation: none - the award is automatic on admission and no application form exists
Transcripts: official academic transcripts must reach Queen's by 31 March 2027 for 2027 entry
English proficiency: results must be sent directly by the testing body, using the same name, surname, date of birth and gender as the admission application, and are valid for two years
Supplementary Application: mandatory for Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing, due 15 February 2027
MAA and SOLUS forms on the Queen's deadlines page are domestic Ontario aid mechanisms and are not part of this international award

research_notes.logo: Found in the university's own logo asset directory, linked as the site wordmark from the header of every queensu.ca page read. Probed live: https://www.queensu.ca/resources/assets/logos/Queens-logo.svg returned HTTP 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, 35,548 bytes. Downloaded and inspected the SVG markup to satisfy the white-wordmark ban: it carries the full-colour Queen's palette (#002452 dark blue, #b90e31 red, #fabd0f gold, #779221 green, #614f87 purple, #876140 brown) and contains no white fill at all, so it is safe on a light card. The white twin https://www.queensu.ca/resources/assets/logos/Queens-logo-reversed.svg also returned 200 image/svg+xml but contains #ffffff and was therefore rejected. The footer asset Queens-university-logo-horizontal-digital-rgb-full-colour-reverse-website.svg is likewise a reverse/white variant and was rejected. /apple-touch-icon.png and /apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png both returned 404; /favicon.ico returned 200 image/vnd.microsoft.icon at 15,086 bytes as a fallback. logo_host_taken is false for this slot, so this is a new key for official_logo_overrides.json keyed by www.queensu.ca, not a duplicate.

research_notes.award_selection_rationale: Queen's publishes a package of international undergraduate awards, exactly the pattern the Canada note describes. The Dean's International Award Program was chosen as the single best-documented because it has an official umbrella name, published per-faculty dollar tiers, published 4-year renewable duration, published eligibility and published renewal conditions. The distinct awards NOT recorded here, so that they are not mistaken for duplicates of this one: International Entrance Scholarship (CAD 9,000, one year, four available), Principal's Global Scholars Undergraduate Award (displaced students via Global Scholars, no amount published), Principal's Scholarship (CAD 7,000, one year), Mehran Bibi Sheikh Memorial Entrance Scholarship (CAD 1,500, one year, two available), Killam American Scholarship (CAD 9,000, US citizens/PRs only).

research_notes.sources_used_for_locating_pages: One web search (restricted to queensu.ca) was used only to locate the official Registrar financial aid pages; no aggregator, blog or listing site was used for any fact. All 6 factual fetches are on the awarding body's own domain.
research_notes.partial_funding_note: Partial tuition award, so fully_funded is false and estimated_uncovered_costs is populated with the per-year shortfall against Queen's published 2026-2027 international total costs plus the Student Association Levy, ancillary fees, UHIP, living costs, travel and immigration.
